A press conference for Korean Broadcasting System (KBS) Drama Special 2026 "Sound: Track" was held at Awesome Ground in Seoul's Yongsan district on the 18th.
 Korean Broadcasting System (KBS) Drama Special 2026 "Sound: Track," which premieres Wednesday, the 18th, at 9:50 p.m., uses "that song" everyone has encountered at least once in their lives as a starting point to explore a range of emotions, including love, separation and growth, across 8 one-act dramas.
